prompts.text: Add a repo.clear_worktrees agentic operation (space/repo, on release-1-2-fixes): it lists the repository's worktrees and the CDD folders beside it, then clears what is done: removes each worktree whose branch is merged into main or whose session is closed (.sessions/_complete), deletes leftover sibling folders that are no longer worktrees, and deletes git's records for worktrees whose folder is gone, taking ownership and clearing read-only flags when Windows refuses, as was done by hand on 2026-11-24. It keeps main, the current worktree, and every worktree whose branch has commits not on main. It answers what it removed and what it kept, with why. A @agent_tool and @mcp on the Repo toolset, a slash command, specs first (heavy spec on a throwaway repository with real worktrees), story map scenario, module docs. Commit, push and repin.

steps.text: Read space/repo: the Repo toolset, its worktree code, module docs and an existing heavy spec
Heavy spec first: a throwaway repository with merged, closed-session, unmerged, current and gone worktrees, a leftover sibling folder and a stale git record
Domain: list worktrees and sibling folders, decide clear or keep with the reason
Clear: remove worktrees, delete leftover folders and stale records, taking ownership and clearing read-only flags when Windows refuses
Publish repo.clear_worktrees as @agent_tool and @mcp on the Repo toolset, with a slash command
Story map scenario and module docs
Run the heavy spec and the repo unit specs
Commit, push, reinstall and repin the dev lane
